THE WALKTHROUGH SECTION CONTAINS NO STEPS. Its two bullets are a drop rate (10%, one random party member) and the rule that you must be HOLDING the matching Goblin food key item when the NM dies. The mission itself is in the three sibling '{{KI}} Seedspall X' sections, whose bullets restart at [1] -- every step below cites those, and each note says which section. That second walkthrough bullet is what puts the food key item in `items` on each NM step; the page also says the food key items are NOT consumed when they spawn the NM, so requiring them is safe.

Evidence is unusually good for a mission: six distinct key items, each granted at its own step, none of them in Reward (empty). Seedspall Roseum/Caerulum/Viridis are spent by the NEXT mission (Gatherer of Light II), but they are OBTAINED here, so they are this mission's evidence, not that one's. Confirmed against resolve.lua: the food items are ki 1085-1087 and the seedspalls ki 1088-1090 -- key items here, unlike the Lux/Luna/Astrum of mission 2 which are ordinary items.

The three chains (Batallia/Rolanberry/Sauromugue) are independent and may be done in any order, but each is ORDERED internally -- food first, then the ??? -- so they are serialised into one spine rather than grouped: a group draws all six at once and would tell you to pop an NM you cannot yet pop. The distinct per-step evidence means the high-water mark still lands correctly whichever chain you do first.

The final 'A Crystalline Prophecy Key' section is the once-a-day coffer loop through Squintrox Dryeyes, plus the warning that accepting a Viridian Key starts a one-real-day timer on the NEXT mission. Reward mechanism, not steps.

SIX PROTOCRYSTALS, ANY THREE. The mission hands you six Domina's seals and asks for at least three attached, so the six Cloisters are one unordered group -- one step each, because a step has ONE zone and these are six zones. The final return to Trodden Snow is the only ordered rung.

NO EVIDENCE ANYWHERE, deliberately, and this is the interesting judgement on the page. The six counterseals are real key items and they resolve cleanly (ki 1197-1202), but the page lists all six in one breath -- 'receive a counterseal Key Item ([KI] Scarlet counterseal, ...)' -- and NEVER says which counterseal comes from which Cloister. Attaching Scarlet to a guessed crystal would be a rung that reads TRUE in the wrong zone, so all six stay null and the note says why. The Domina's seals are likewise unmapped, so `items` is empty on the crystal steps even though a seal is obviously consumed by each; they are granted by the mission itself, so requiring them would gate nothing anyway.

The return step carries items_partial: the real requirement is 'any three of six counterseals', an OR-of-combinations the schema cannot express at all.

Each crystal is THREE clicks, not one: click, click again to enter the 'Sugar-coated Directive' battlefield, then click a third time after the fight to attach the seal and collect the counterseal. That is one action locus and stays one step. The weakened Prime Avatar inside is never named -- the page says only 'the corresponding Prime Avatar' -- so `mobs` is empty rather than invented. If you leave before collecting the counterseal you can return for it without refighting.

Bullet 5 is the gil reward table (3/4/5/6 seals -> 3k/10k/30k/50k), an outcome, not a step. The 'A Shantotto Ascension Key' section after the walkthrough is the once-a-day repeat for the Bird key and the Tenshodo coffer -- a reward loop that runs AFTER the mission is over, and it needs the Tenshodo Membership quest for the door. Not steps.

THE BLACK BOOK IS NOT USED AS EVIDENCE, and this is the one place on the page I am knowingly leaving accuracy on the table. It is a key item (ki 1203), it is obtained mid-walkthrough at bullet 5, and it is spent at bullet 7 -- so on the face of it, holding it proves the soul-plate step is done and points the ladder at the Outcropping. But it is also the page's entire Reward field, and AUTHORING hard rule 7 says a Reward is not evidence. I obeyed the rule rather than argue my way around it. A human who wants the extra rung should add {ki Black book x1} as evidence on step 3; the reason it is absent is the rule, not an oversight.

SOUL PLATES ARE NOT EVIDENCE EITHER, and here the rule and the reading agree. Soul Plate is one generic item id (2477) shared by every photograph in the game; a player who has ever touched a Soultrapper can be holding three of the wrong monsters. That is a rung that reads TRUE for the wrong reason, which is worse than a rung that never reads TRUE at all.

THE THREE MONSTERS ARE ASSIGNED PER PLAYER. Andrause names three of the Sea Serpent Grotto pool at random, and the page lists the whole pool -- roughly two dozen names across four Beastcoin-door tiers. Recording all of them as mobs would put a watch on two dozen monsters of which three matter, so `mobs` is empty and the pool stays in the note. Depending on which three you draw you may need a Silver, Mythril or Gold Beastcoin for the doors; Unity Warp 125 lands past the Gold door.

BULLET 7 IS NOT A STEP OF THIS MISSION. Clicking the Outcropping a second time 'will immediately start the next mission' and drop you into the fight with three Tenshodo agents -- that fight belongs to Enemy of the Empire (II). This mission ends on the bullet-6 cutscene. Bullet 3 is Soultrapper how-to (ranged slot, ammo slot, does not work under Sneak or Invisible).

The 'Notes' section after the walkthrough lists five Adoulin missions that BLOCK this cutscene while you are on them (SoA 3-6-3, 3-6-4, 4-5, 4-5-1, 5-4-1). A negative prerequisite has no expression in this schema at all -- there is no 'not currently on X' -- so it is recorded here only.
